# Vendored from anthropic-experimental/agentic-misalignment (MIT)

These files come from the Agentic Misalignment suite, licensed MIT (see `LICENSE`), fetched 2026-11-07:

- The blackmail and leaking prompts, generated with the suite's `scripts/generate_prompts.py` for the condition "explicit goal (America), replacement threat". There is one folder per scenario, holding `system_prompt.txt`, `user_prompt.txt` and `email_content.txt`.
- The suite's classifier prompts and target addresses, in `classifiers/`.

They are used unchanged.
